description.zh:
通过指定分配的地址段查询分配信息。

> 目前，只支持IPv4类型的地址段。
description.en:
The allocated CIDR block that you want to query.

> Only IPv4 CIDR blocks are supported.

description.zh: IPAM地址池CIDR分配的实例ID列表。
description.en: A list of instance IDs of the IPAM pool CIDR block allocations.

description.zh:
IPAM地址池CIDR分配的名称。

长度为1～128个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头。
description.en:
The name of the IPAM pool CIDR block allocation.

The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.
The instance ID of the IPAM pool.

description.zh: 分批次查询时返回的最多条目数。取值范围：1~100，默认值为10。
description.en: The maximum number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10.

description.zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
- 如果**NextToken**为空表示没有下一次查询。
- 如果**NextToken**有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌。
description.en:
The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. Valid values:

- If **NextToken** is empty, no next page exists.

- If a value is returned for **NextToken**, the value is the token that determines the start point of the next query.

description.zh:
IPAM地址池CIDR分配所属IPAM Pool的所在地域。

> 当IPAM地址池CIDR分配所属IPAM Pool具备地域属性时，该属性为IPAM Pool的所在地域。当IPAM地址池CIDR分配所属IPAM Pool不具备地域属性时，该属性为IPAM托管地域。
description.en:
The region of the IPAM pool that contains the CIDR block allocation.

> If the IPAM pool has a specific region, this parameter specifies that region. If the IPAM pool does not have a specific region, this parameter specifies the managed region of IPAM.

title.zh: 查询IPAM地址池的CIDR分配信息

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vpcipam list-ipam-pool-allocations --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --ipam-pool-id ipam-pool-6rcq3tobayc20t0000 --ipam-pool-allocation-ids ipam-pool-alloc-112za33e40000 --cidr 192.168.1.0/24 --ipam-pool-allocation-name test_name --next-token FFmyTO70tTpLG6I3FmYAXGKPd0000 --max-results 10 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun vpcipam ListIpamPoolAllocations --region cn-hangzhou --Cidr '192.168.1.0/24' --NextToken FFmyTO70tTpLG6I3FmYAXGKPd0000 --IpamPoolId 'ipam-pool-6rcq3tobayc20t0000' --MaxResults 10 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --IpamPoolAllocationIds.1 'ipam-pool-alloc-112za33e40000' --IpamPoolAllocationName test_name
